name: GPU Helper
description: Experimental iOS Metal compute mod with active-gameplay overlay attachment and GPU-assisted static decoration visibility culling.

debug-overlay.name: Show in-game GPU diagnostics overlay
debug-overlay.description: Display Metal decoration visibility dispatches and candidate counts; attached from the active gameplay update hook.

gpu-decoration-culling.name: GPU-assisted static decoration culling
gpu-decoration-culling.description: Use Metal to test ungrouped static decoration bounds against the camera. Cocos still draws visible objects; gameplay updates, triggers, collisions, and player physics remain on the normal game path. Experimental and fail-open if GPU work fails.
